description: This source file defines helper functions for color space conversions between sRGB and scRGB within the PDFsharp library, including structures for representing colors.

classes.name: ColorHelper
classes.description: Contains static methods for converting color values between sRGB and scRGB color spaces.

methods.name: sRgbToScRgb
methods.description: Converts a byte representing an sRGB color component to a float in scRGB color space.

methods.name: ScRgbTosRgb
methods.description: Converts a float in scRGB color space to a byte representing an sRGB color component.
